# MotionMint — UI with Feel

> Interaction-first React & Next.js UI toolkit with optional Web Audio & haptic feedback and a 29-theme design token system.

## Status
- Implemented Free Components: 44 (+ `motion-reveal`, `sound-engine`, `ai-types` = 47 registry items)
- Planned Roadmap Inventory: 160+ items across 22 categories
- Themes: 29 complete token profiles

## Registry Installation
Namespace: `@motionmint`
Local registry endpoint: `http://localhost:3000/r/{name}.json`

Configure `components.json`:
```json
{
  "registries": {
    "@motionmint": "http://localhost:3000/r/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

Install any available component:
```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @motionmint/<slug>
```

## Available Components (12)
- `bounce-dots-loader` — CSS-keyframe three-dot loader (`/components/bounce-dots-loader`)
- `wiggle-text` — Character/word wiggle typography (`/components/wiggle-text`)
- `jelly-button` — Magnetic spring button (`/components/jelly-button`)
- `ripple-button` — Pointer-origin ripple button (`/components/ripple-button`)
- `copy-button` — Clipboard copy button with error fallback (`/components/copy-button`)
- `sound-toggle` — Accessible switch with waveform & audio cues (`/components/sound-toggle`)
- `progress-ring` — SVG progress ring & linear bar (`/components/progress-ring`)
- `skeleton-shimmer` — Composable CSS shimmer placeholders (`/components/skeleton-shimmer`)
- `dropzone` — Click & drag-and-drop file selector (`/components/dropzone`)
- `swipe-card-deck` — Layered spring swipe card stack (`/components/swipe-card-deck`)
- `thinking-loader` — Multi-stage async status indicator (`/components/thinking-loader`)
- `flip-card` — Direction-aware 3D flip card (`/components/flip-card`)
- `motion-reveal` — Accessible scroll & entrance reveal wrapper (`/motion`)

## Key Routes
- `/components` — Catalogue (defaults to Available Now, plus Full Inventory tab)
- `/playground` — Interactive Playground
- `/motion` — Motion Lab & shared presets
- `/themes` — 29-Theme Gallery
- `/sounds` — Web Audio & Haptics Sound Lab
- `/docs/installation` — Registry installation guide
